description: Defines a template class 'WindowedFilter' implementing Kathleen Nichols' algorithm for tracking min/max estimates over a time window, used in congestion control within QUIC protocol.

classes.name: quic::WindowedFilter
classes.description: Template class for maintaining min/max estimates over a sliding time window, parameterized by measurement type, comparison functor, timestamp type, and time delta type.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the filter with a new sample and timestamp, expiring old estimates and maintaining the top three estimates within the window.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets all estimates to a new sample and timestamp.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the filter to its initial state.
